title: A complete setup commits no secret and no absolute home path
statement: After a complete setup against an environment-authenticated provider and an enabled research connection, the committed `.pi/settings.json` and `.pi/kiln.json` are asserted to contain no API key, token, authorisation header, credential-derived fingerprint, or absolute user path.
notes: ⚠️ MOVED FROM ACC-0048, WORDING UNCHANGED. ACC-0048 accepted only TSK-0029 but required a complete setup, which is TSK-0060 - and TSK-0060 depends on TSK-0029, so neither could be accepted first. ACC-0048 now asserts the bytes the merge and `ensureProjectId` produce; this criterion keeps the end-to-end assertion with the task that can actually run a complete setup.
